description: Nodi Stradali is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale. The road sections dataset together with the Road Nodes dataset allow the management of the road graph as a map representation of the road arches, their junction nodes. Appliedly, the two datasets allow: the management of the Municipal Road, which allows the maintenance of a unique archive of the roads and their characteristics. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Road knots" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
